Frontend pressure refers to high demand on the frontend, so the cluster needs to handle that efficiently.

Request routing is the process of directing requests to the appropriate parts of the cluster. Queueing systems like FIFO or priority queues are common here. Tail latency is the time a request takes to be processed after being queued. Cache transfer involves moving data between different layers of the cluster. Role switching refers to changing the processing role of a request, which can affect latency. Batch completion is when multiple requests are processed in a batch, and GPU utilization is about how much GPU resources are being used. Throughput tradeoffs involve balancing between processing speed and resource usage.
